title: Read recursive lambda expressions
description: You follow a singleton base case and an operator passed into recursion.

steps.description: You read the Python expression beside its Scheme counterpart. L[0] selects the first element, and L[1:] supplies the remaining list to the recursive call.

steps.question: Which branch handles sumlist([4])?
steps.answer: len(L)==1 selects L[0], so the call returns 4 without another recursive call.

steps.description: You see the recorded sums 6, 4, and 5050. oplist keeps the same recursive structure while taking the combining operation as a parameter.
You supply addition, multiplication, and max to oplist. The recorded results are 12, 48, and 9 respectively.
